user.title: Set up Shelly phase netting
user.description: Raw data is read locally from the Shelly. The backfill determines when the new counters start. The Shelly must run in the triphase profile (3 phases).

reauth_confirm.title: Renew credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The Shelly "{name}" rejected the stored credentials. Please enter them again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the Shelly
reconfigure.description: New IP address or hostname of the Shelly. It must be the same device as before. An empty password field keeps the stored password.

data.password: Password (leave empty to keep the stored one)

error.emdata_unavailable: The Shelly does not provide EMData. Is it running in the monophase profile? This integration needs the triphase profile.
error.unknown: Unexpected error (see the Home Assistant log for details)
error.wrong_device: This is a different device than the configured one (the MAC address does not match)

abort.reconfigure_successful: The connection details have been updated
